description: Elections Commission - E. M. W. G. W. K. Ekanayaka, has ceased to be a member of the United People's Freedom Alliance of the Wilgamuiwa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice declares a vacancy in a local government authority (Wilgamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls under electoral processes and specifically relates to the status of elected members, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7) according to the classification criteria for electoral matters including candidate registrations and member status declarations.
